notes: Accessed entirely via Claude-in-Chrome (own tab). robots.txt (https://potterybarn.in/robots.txt) has no Claude-specific disallow and its 'Disallow: /collections*' (plural) does not block '/collection/<slug>' (singular) pages used here; Googlebot fully allowed. This is a Reliance-run India franchise on Fynd commerce (not the WSI/Constructor.io platform used by Williams Sonoma US/Pottery Barn US) so the WSI category-tree/PLP JSON endpoints from the qa_notes reusable finding do not apply here -- the mega-menu DOM and the site's XML sitemaps were used instead. Tree source: (1) full furniture mega-menu parsed from the homepage DOM via javascript_tool (same-origin, no fetch to endpoints); (2) cross-checked against https://potterybarn.in/sitemap/collections.sitemap.xml (408 total <loc> entries, 53 containing 'furniture') per the mandatory sitemap-cross-check rule. The sitemap surfaced 12 additional furniture-slugged URLs not in the mega-menu (Drink Table, Entryway Furniture, Storage Cabinets, TV Consoles, Buffet Sideboard and Cabinets, Small Space Furniture, Bar Cabinets & Carts, Outdoor Sectional Sofas, Outdoor Sidetables, plus alias slugs furniture-dining-table, dining-room-furniture, furniture-living-room-furnture). Each was opened and checked: every one of them either rendered no listing at all (Drink Table: breadcrumb present but no product grid/count -- treated as a dead/orphan sitemap entry, not a live 0-item category) or rendered with breadcrumb truncated to just 'Home' (i.e. NOT placed under Furniture > <department> in the site's own breadcrumb, unlike every real leaf) and a product list that was byte-for-byte identical to an already-counted leaf's list (e.g. 'Bar Cabinets & Carts' = the exact same 6 SKUs as 'Bar Furniture & Stools'; 'Outdoor Sidetables' 19 items = the exact same list as indoor 'Coffee Tables', clearly mistagged; 'furniture-dining-table' 12 items = identical to 'Dining Table'). All 12 were excluded as orphan/duplicate/roll-up pages per the NEVER-EXTRACT filter-page rule, matching the precedent set in the prior Home-Decor pass on this same site (Outdoor Dinnerware/Outdoor Serveware roll-ups). 'Leather Furniture' and both 'Benches & Ottomans' / 'Bookcases & Shelves' pairs (Living Room vs Home Office share underlying SKUs) were KEPT despite product overlap because those URLs carry a full, correct 'Home > Furniture > <Department> > <Node>' breadcrumb and are genuine peer entries in the mega-menu / on-page category sidebar -- unlike the excluded orphans they are part of the site's own official taxonomy, just with shared inventory tagging. qty for every leaf = the rendered listing header text ('N items' / 'N item' next to 'Hide Filters'), confirmed to vary per category (11 to 28) with no repeated/site-wide constant and no round-number pattern, so no corroboration source was needed. Every leaf URL was opened directly and its breadcrumb trail matched the category clicked (h1/breadcrumb check per Trap #2). Excluded per project scope: Sale/Clearance ('furniture-sale', 'clearance-furniture', 'dining-furniture-sale', 'sale-all-sale-bedroom-furniture', 'outdoor-furniture-sale', 'sale-all-sale-sale-furniture'), 'furniture-back-in-stock' and 'furniture-in-stock--quick-ship-furniture' (cross-cutting stock filters), and named product-line marketing collections (Benchwright, Malcolm, Toulouse, Sausalito furniture collections). Mattresses/bedding, lighting, mirrors/wall art, rugs, kitchen/dining tableware, cushions/decor, bath were out of scope and not touched. No furniture category read 0 or an absurdly low/suspicious count.
